title: the Deep Rising
author: A. M. Okafor
blurb: Juniper Eriksen, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, has spent twenty years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the jump window closes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
